_doc: Draft main Hán Việt reading chosen by the course author (Claude) for kanji whose sources disagree or give several readings. A kanji listed here stays flagged as ambiguous (app shows *) unless both sources agree on exactly this reading alone; teachers check them (docs/review-notes.md). Lower case. An empty string marks a kanji made in Japan (kokuji) with no Hán Việt reading.
_words: Draft Hán Việt reading of whole words (display form), one syllable per kanji ( - for a kokuji), chosen for the meaning in the word. Checked: each syllable must be a known reading of its kanji.
